specification.recording_probe: 14 seven-player initial-deal commands per event scale, plus a separately profiled complete round and post-initial actions
specification.scope_note: Measure all specified scales and report misses and supported scale explicitly. Profiling is separate from primary latency. Do not drop slow cases, change math, or relax request budgets. Synthetic data only.

resources.note: Sampled own process tree; exited-between-samples CPU/memory may be missed; not system-wide usage

events.scope: Main-thread initial-deal probe; auto numeric and sidebet workers disabled to isolate UI/ledger costs. All-services long-shoe probe is separate.
